NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshots still aren't a matching before/after pair**

New: The author replaced the "After" screenshot, with no new code pushed. Missing: the "Before" image is still the one from the issue (identical file, 1110px wide), while the new "After" is a different size (703px wide), so the two don't show the same message and window. The author also hasn't said how the pill behaves when several people react, which the #design thread asked to be clear.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave the PR unassigned.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating! The "Before" screenshot is still the one from the issue, and it's a different size from your "After". Please take both from your own dev server, with the same message, reactions and window size, as described in the [precise before/after guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
